purpose: Defines the COMPLETE set of text that the protocol authorizes anyone to send to Role A before reveal. The verifier checks every entry and fails closed if the protocol authorizes a participant-facing string that is not registered here. An earlier revision modelled only packet sections 2 and 3 as participant-facing, which left the fallback clarification unchecked.
governing_rule: Any text the protocol authorizes a deliverer to send to Role A is participant-facing, regardless of which file it lives in. Sending an unregistered string to Role A is a procedural failure and the run is not an R5 run.

B_authorized_fallback_clarifications.exact_string: Answer as you see fit; there is no target answer. Any conclusion you can justify from your own analysis is acceptable.
B_authorized_fallback_clarifications.when: the respondent asks what is wanted, what a good answer resembles, or whether a direction is promising
B_authorized_fallback_clarifications.rule: Delivered verbatim. No addition, no paraphrase, no elaboration. Names no answer shape.
B_authorized_fallback_clarifications.supersedes: An earlier fallback ended '...and concluding that the question is ill-posed is an acceptable outcome', which named one answer shape and reintroduced directional priming.

C_architecture_phase_question.exact_string: Given the answer you have just finalised, determine whether it implies any minimal or canonical way of structuring such a description. State and justify whatever conclusion you reach.
C_architecture_phase_question.when: after the contract answer is declared final, preserved and hashed, and BEFORE the contamination questionnaire and before any reveal
C_architecture_phase_question.contamination_note: This question discloses that a structuring question is of interest, which the contract elicitation did not. It therefore contaminates the ARCHITECTURE answer with respect to the existence of a structuring question, though not with respect to any particular structure. It cannot contaminate the contract answer, which is already frozen and hashed. This limitation is disclosed on every architecture-phase claim.

D_other_pre_reveal_messages.exact_string: Please confirm that your answer is final.
D_other_pre_reveal_messages.rule: The only permitted finality prompt. Carries no content about the answer.

D_other_pre_reveal_messages.exact_string: Thank you. Please complete the following questionnaire.
D_other_pre_reveal_messages.when: immediately before the contamination questionnaire, after all freezing
D_other_pre_reveal_messages.rule: The questionnaire body itself is registered separately in contamination-questionnaire-v1.0.json and is DELIBERATELY NOT BLINDED, because it must name the concepts it asks about. It is therefore administered only after every answer is frozen and hashed.

completeness_declaration: The protocol authorizes no participant-facing text other than S1-S7. Adding one without registering it here is a protocol violation. The verifier enforces that every registered string passes the blinding watchlist, and that no packet file contains an unregistered quoted fallback.

exempt_from_blinding_with_reason.contamination-questionnaire-v1.0.json: Must name the concepts it screens for. Administered only after all answers are frozen and hashed, so it cannot contaminate any frozen artifact. It CAN contaminate a later architecture phase, which is why the architecture phase is ordered before it.
